hero.title: Full Stack Developer (Backend Oriented — Node.js · TypeScript · Golang)
hero.bio: Full Stack developer oriented to high-performance backend architecture with Node.js, TypeScript and Golang. Building the invisible foundations of the modern web.

item1.description: Designed and developed a sales and inventory management SaaS using Next.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.
achievements: Defined the initial product stack prioritizing development speed, low operational cost, and maintainability
Optimized PostgreSQL/Supabase queries and data flows, reducing load times from ~3s to under 0.5s
Implemented JWT authentication, route protection, and secure cookies in Next.js
Integrated Transbank OneClick Mall for subscriptions and recurring payment automation

item2.description: On-site consultancy — gathered requirements directly with the client's IT team and management, operating fully autonomously in English.
achievements: On-site consultancy in Auckland operating completely autonomously in English with direct client interaction
Developed UI improvements prioritizing accessibility, achieving a 15% increase in user interaction
Optimized frontend achieving a 25% improvement in Core Web Vitals and asset load times

item3.description: Designed and implemented a content management and publishing system with Node.js, MongoDB, and Astro.
achievements: Designed REST APIs for decoupled consumption from an Astro frontend
Integrated Cloudinary for optimized image storage, transformation, and delivery
Implemented JWT-based authentication and access control for administrative operations
Set up automated deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions for CI/CD standardization
Built the Astro frontend achieving 90+/100 Lighthouse scores in performance and SEO

item4.description: Participated in maintenance and improvement of existing web platforms, collaborating on new features and bug fixes.
achievements: Maintained and improved existing web functionalities, collaborating on new features and bug fixes
Integrated third-party APIs and webhooks to automate internal flows and data synchronization
Worked alongside design and marketing teams on product-aligned feature implementation

item5.description: Implemented backend integrations with WooCommerce REST API for product, order, and user synchronization.
achievements: Implemented WooCommerce REST API integrations for product, order, and user sync between services
Developed JWT-protected endpoints for authentication and authorization flows in internal integrations
Optimized sync processes using pagination, batching, and retry strategies for data consistency
Set up CI/CD pipelines to automate deployments and reduce operational errors from manual processes

about.label: About Me
about.heading:
Behind the
code.
about.paragraph1: My name is Francisco, though in the dev ecosystem I go by fco-gt. I started programming at 15 with Node.js and haven't stopped since. Today I work as a Full Stack Developer focused on Backend and Systems Architecture.
about.paragraph2: I've worked on early-stage projects where I had the opportunity to define architectures from scratch, make technology design decisions, and optimize APIs and databases to scale with hundreds of thousands of records.
about.paragraph3: I work primarily with Node.js as my main stack, but I also have experience building with Golang and frontend frameworks like Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. I'm also experienced with both relational and NoSQL databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.

item1.title: GoPotency — Idempotency in Go
item1.description: Open-source Go middleware guaranteeing idempotency for HTTP endpoints. Supports body-hash and header-based key strategies with PostgreSQL or Redis backends. Designed for zero-duplicate guarantees in payment, webhook, and event-processing systems.

item2.title: QuickAttendance — Go Migration
item2.description: Full migration of Node.js attendance system to Go using Clean Architecture. Multi-tenant support for 10+ orgs, async processing with RabbitMQ, real-time monitoring via Prometheus/Grafana.

item3.title: AutoAttendance — Microservices
item3.description: End-to-end attendance management with QR check-in and geofencing. Microservices architecture handling 100+ concurrent users with sub-200ms API response times.

topgg.title: Bot Status Notice
paragraphs: Mankekito is currently undergoing a major update. While the original code is deprecated and the bot is temporarily offline, you can still view its profile on Top.gg, a professional Discord bot listing platform.

The bot achieved official verification status and served over 10,000 users across more than 260 servers during its active period. A new version with improved features and modern architecture is in development.
